desc:
But still... aren't Gengetsu and Mugetsu literal blank slates? 🤨 The only idea I've picked up would be that they're the twin moons of the "Fantasy World" Yūka's mansion is in.

They would be a nice addition to Gensōkyō, wouldn't they? Two extra moons – like Masser and Secunda back in *The Elder Scrolls...*
